title: Dropdown's chevron is a rendered icon, not the background image its specification describes
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists
details:
`components/Dropdown.md:100` says the arrow is drawn with `appearance: none` and a custom background SVG or pseudo-element. `:101` specifies a right-aligned chevron using CSS `background-image` with an inline SVG data URI.

`src/components/Dropdown.tsx:100` renders a lucide `ChevronDown` as a sibling of the select. `src/styles/components/dropdown.css` has no `background-image` rule anywhere, and absolutely positions the icon instead.

A consumer hiding or restyling the arrow targets a background property that does not exist, and does not expect the extra SVG node the component puts in the DOM.

notes.text: Found by the same review that produced CUI-032 through CUI-047, and missed when those records were written. Filed here so the review's findings are complete. Session agent confirmed every citation against the tree at 0ef7ea4.
